$schema_note: MTower Studio — wardrobe catalog (costumes and uniforms) and wear states. Descriptions contain clothing only. Tokens in {CURLY_CAPS} are filled from a production's production_config.json overrides.

wardrobe.name: Egyptian Army commando (Sa'iqa) field uniform, 1973
wardrobe.prompt: a 1973 Egyptian army commando sand-khaki cotton field uniform (jacket with two buttoned chest pockets, trousers bloused into black leather combat boots) with sleeves rolled to the forearm, {HEADGEAR}
wardrobe.field_kit: a 1970s Soviet-pattern khaki canvas chest rig with three closed-flap pouches for AK magazines, plain cotton straps and simple metal buckles (no plastic, no elastic loops, no open-top pouches, not a modern tactical vest), an aluminium canteen in a canvas cover on a web belt

tokens.HEADGEAR: Set per production; default placeholder 'bare-headed with short black hair' pending verification

wardrobe.verify: Headgear, insignia, and exact fabric color against 1973 reference photos

wardrobe.name: Egyptian Air Force helicopter pilot, 1973
wardrobe.prompt: Egyptian Air Force helicopter pilot in a plain olive flight suit with no flag or badge patches, a dull olive-green flight helmet with a boom microphone, flight gloves

wardrobe.name: Egyptian Army general officer, service dress, 1973
wardrobe.prompt: Egyptian army major general's khaki service uniform: on each shoulder strap a gold eagle above two crossed curved sabres (the Egyptian major general's insignia, no stars, no baton), red collar tabs with gold embroidery
wardrobe.verify: Collar tabs and insignia. Egyptian liwa (major general): gold Eagle of Saladin over two crossed curved sabres — not the British crossed sword and baton; red gorget patches are correct for Egyptian general officers (British-inherited). Checked 2026-10-16 against the Egyptian MoD rank chart (via Wikipedia, Military ranks of Egypt).

wardrobe.name: Israeli tank crew, 1973
wardrobe.prompt: 1973 Israeli tank crewman in olive-drab coveralls and a padded tanker helmet with headset

wardrobe.name: Israeli infantry, 1973
wardrobe.prompt: 1973 Israeli infantry soldier in an olive-green uniform and a helmet with netting, carrying an FN FAL rifle

wardrobe.name: Nile Delta village woman, 1970s
wardrobe.prompt: black cotton galabeya and a long black headscarf (tarha)

wardrobe.name: Cairo working-class woman, 1970s
wardrobe.prompt: modest 1970s knee-length dress with long sleeves and a simple patterned headscarf

wardrobe.name: Cairo boy, 1970s
wardrobe.prompt: striped cotton shirt and shorts, worn sandals

wear_states.WEAR_MUD: trousers soaked dark with mud and brine to above the knees, jacket splashed and wet, water dripping
wear_states.WEAR_SALT: clothing stiff and grey with dried white salt crust, salt crystals on skin and eyebrows
wear_states.WEAR_SAND: clothing caked with wet sand over salt and mud, grit in every crease
wear_states.WEAR_BATTLE: clothing torn and blackened with smoke and dust, sweat-soaked, face streaked with dust (no blood or wounds)
wear_states.WEAR_GAUNT: clothing faded and filthy after days in the desert, gaunt sunburned face, cracked lips
wear_states.WEAR_POSTWAR: clean pressed uniform, thinner face, older eyes

$off_duty_note: In these wear states the character is off duty: a wardrobe's field_kit (webbing, magazines, canteen) is left out of the prompt.
